warm_memory.goal: Clarify the visible meaning of the strongest-brain decision queue.
warm_memory.classification: coding.complex + continuation; frontend cockpit usefulness repair
constraints: Do not change the strongest-brain decision queue API contract.
Keep frontend styling as dense internal dark cockpit UI.
Stage and commit only intentional Phase 24 files; leave task_status.md and well-ambient.db unstaged.
decisions: Preserved backend API compatibility and carried queue item source through frontend normalization.
Added a selected decision focus panel with decision kind, idle cost, handling entry, suggested action, and source counts.
Added per-card source, decision type, no-action cost, and clearer entry labels.
Kept non-Agenda queue items visible while labeling them as source-located work when they cannot enter the old intervention form.
findings: The queue's weakness was not missing data, but insufficient translation from data into decision language.
The backend already emits schedule/execution/context source fields; the frontend previously hid them as generic strongest-brain items.
task_status.md and well-ambient.db are unrelated runtime/data changes for this phase.
validation: pnpm build in web: passed with existing Svelte warnings.
